verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no real-time dashboard for live system metrics or worker/browser pool status. The closest item is a Usage API that returns real-time credit and concurrency usage. That is a programmatic building block and an adjacent feature, not the dashboard or pool-status view the story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard

citations.quote: Read real-time credit and concurrency usage for the authenticated ScrapingBee account.
